notes: Layout source bytes are a synthetic adapter capture (compact sorted UTF-8 JSON); SP-273 says these digests bind the bytes the Home source adapter actually supplies and do not make the fixture encoder the canonical Home serializer. Identity capture and migration-core bytes use canonical MessagePack (DL-270). Each invalid case applies its ops to the named valid case; rejected_by names the schema or the invariant (I1-I9 in the schema's $comment) that refuses it.

valid.why: Empty Home4 slot: no binding, layouts, bytes, readback, event or pending custody.
First Home4 generation keeps the final empty Home3 core as its one prior migration core, re-encoded in canonical MessagePack (DL-270).
Prepared v2 write: v2 prior and candidate records, their exact source bytes as binary fields, pending SIR custody; no readback or event yet.
Readback-verified v2 write with the frozen 2.0.0 event semantics (CV-361 panel_moved).

Committed v2 receipt: v2 readback key, 2.0.0 event, Home4 owner result, canonical MessagePack identity capture; original publication and append receipt carried from Home3 (shared SP-286/CV-339 custody, not recomputed here).

invalid.why: A v2 write holds v2 records only (SP-330).
DL-270 retires the base64 field names.
Home3 values stay with the Home3 reader.
A payload-store reference is only for bytes over 16 KiB (SP-337, SP-340).
An unresolved operation keeps both exact source byte captures.
Only CV-361 2.0.0 commands bind a v2 write; terminal.workgroup_moved's command retired (DL-181).
DL-270 retires the JSON migration-core codec for new writes.
New appends carry 2.0.0 only (CV-361).
DL-270 retires the JSON capture id for new writes.
The v1 key is read-only migration input (SP-330).
The conversion has no admitted command and never uses this custody (SP-273, SP-330).
The Home4 owner result is version 2.0.0.
16,385 inline bytes need a payload-store reference.
Captured bytes must hash to the prior layout hash.
The candidate is exactly the next revision.
Both layouts belong to the slot's Project.
The frozen event names the admitted command.
Binding, owner result and SIR values name one command.
An applied change advances the revision by exactly one.
Readback certifies this Project's v2 key.
The event names the one dispatch receipt.
The event ID is formed from the operation digest.
Capture bytes are canonical MessagePack, not JSON (DL-270).
The SIR outcome points at the Home4 owner result.
The prior wrapper joins the current migration.
Core bytes are canonical MessagePack of the core.
